Background and Motivation: Building directly on our lab’s prior work linking motivation scales and learning‑analytics traces to predict engagement, this project tests how the content and framing of online homework feedback shape students’ self‑regulated learning (SRL) adaptations over a semester and the downstream implications for performance and equity; doing so bridges moment‑to‑moment behavioral signals (clickstreams) with semester‑level outcomes in introductory psychology, a context where we already have strong instructor partnerships and analytics access.
